case.title: 碳边境调节：欧盟让谁为钢铁的碳埋单

observed_firm_evidence: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper 11366 on Turkish manufacturer responses to the July 2021 CBAM announcement
model_results: Horowitz, van de Ven and Holtz, Environmental Research Letters 21 034025 (2026), global steel scenarios
exposure_method_note: World Bank CBAM Exposure Indices Methodological Note (2025)

why_not_counted: The draft and evidence map were produced by the current executor; no independent L5 review exists.
The baseline-gain comparison is an executor self-assessment, not an independent or user-confirmed comparison.
The 2026 definitive regime is in force, but the first annual declaration and certificate surrender are due in 2027; no complete 2026 outcome is available.
The real empirical study concerns Turkish firms after the July 2021 announcement, not measured 2026 certificate-system outcomes.
The global steel numbers are model scenarios, not observed policy results.

actual_retrieval.mode: Public read-only HTTP retrieval and local synthesis
known_failures: One incorrect Commission URL guess returned page not found

limits: This is genuine source research, not a synthetic fixture.
It improves W41's candidate pool but does not satisfy the independent-review or completed-outcome requirements.
No claim is made that CBAM has already delivered the modelled global emission reduction.
No claim is made that the European Commission, World Bank or IOP endorses this article.
No user reading, stage gate or publication authorization is inferred.

interpretation_correction_20261101.basis: W41 original card and canonical bounded-closure/qualified-unknown rules
interpretation_correction_20261101.scope: Prior statements about unobserved future outcomes limit those outcome claims, not the eligibility of all bounded current research. Independent Review, baseline/gain and required coverage remain actual missing inputs.
